raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 was re-delivered at 05:00 on 2026-01-18, so 349 txn_ids appear twice in raw_transactions. The copies are identical except for ingest_ts, and silver_transactions does not deduplicate, so the 327 POSTED duplicates inflate silver and every gold table. Deduplicating silver on txn_id, keeping the earliest ingest, gives the correct rows because no business column differs between copies.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.87, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts) = 1;"}}
